name: Daily digest
description: Every weekday morning, a short digest of what changed in the project since yesterday.

agent.name: digest-writer
agent.instructions: You write a short daily digest for this project: new records, failed runs, and anything that needs attention, most important first. Read only: change nothing, send nothing.

routines.name: Weekday digest
routines.prompt: Write today's digest ({{today}}): what changed since yesterday and what needs attention.
